program_name: Diploma in Information & Communication Technology with a specialism in Data Informatics

requirements.general_text: SPM 3 Credits in at least 3 subjects at SPM level including Mathematics#, with a minimum of a pass in Bahasa Malaysia and Sejarah (History). Candidates with only a Pass in Maths in SPM will be required to complete and pass "Mathematics and Statistics for Computing" in their Semester 1 of Diploma. IGCSE/O-LEVELS 3 Credits (Grade C & above) in at least 3 subjects at IGCSE/O-Levels including Mathematics#. Candidates with only a Pass in Maths in IGCSE/O-Level will be required to complete and pass "Mathematics and Statistics for Computing" in their Semester 1 of Diploma. UEC 3 Credits (Grade B & above) in at least 3 subjects in UEC including Mathematics#. Candidates with only a Pass in Maths in UEC will be required to complete and pass "Mathematics and Statistics for Computing" in their Semester 1 of Diploma. Certificate Pass relevant Certificate Programme or its equivalent.   English Requirements IELTS: 4.5 TOEFL IBT: 33 Pearson (PTE): 43 MUET: Band 3
